headline: EU Proposes Ban on Russian-Insured Oil Tankers and Refinery Services
summary: The European Commission proposed a new sanctions package banning tankers insured in Russia and prohibiting European firms from maintaining or repairing Russian energy infrastructure.
why: The European Union is a primary enforcement jurisdiction for Russian energy sanctions, impacting global maritime shipping and refined petroleum supply lines.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Restrictions on Russian tanker insurance and refinery services threaten to disrupt crude trade flows.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Proposed sanctions restricting tanker insurance and oil refinery services increased concerns regarding global crude shipping constraints.
